title: TreeFlex: Agents Navigating Their Own Search Trees

paragraphs.en: A ReAct-style agent accumulates observations, intermediate results, and failed attempts in a single context. As this context grows, stale and off-path information consumes its limited capacity and obscures relevant evidence, making focused reasoning increasingly difficult. We introduce TreeFlex , a framework in which the agent’s own policy decides where to search. The agent records each intermediate state, with a short summary, as a node in a search tree maintained by the harness. The policy is a single language model that acts in two roles. In the Reflection role, it has a global view of the tree through these summaries and picks a node to resume, together with an instruction. In the Execution role, the harness restores the path that led to that node, and the model carries out the instruction with the usual task tools until it saves a new node or proposes a solution, which Reflection then approves or sends back to another node. Through these choices, the policy decides whether to deepen the current line, branch from or revisit an earlier state, verify a proposal, or stop, without a fixed traversal order or a score for each node. We train navigation, task actions, checkpointing, and proposal review jointly with a tree-aware adaptation of GRPO, using task-level outcome rewards augmented by process rewards. After small-scale RL of a 4B model, with the same active-context limit for all methods, TreeFlex reaches 48.8% accuracy on a challenging deep-research benchmark, versus 41.5% for flat ReAct and 42.8% for FoldAgent , and its Pass@8 is about ten points higher than either. On SWE-bench Verified, with all three systems trained with RL from the same 9B model, TreeFlex resolves 54.9% of tasks, versus 43.3% for FoldAgent and 45.2% for its step-wise variant.

paragraphs.en: On long-horizon tasks, an agent rarely reaches a solution in one straight path. Several candidate solutions may build on the same partial progress, a failed attempt may still reach a state worth resuming from, and later evidence may make an abandoned direction worth revisiting. In deep research, an agent may check several candidate answers against the same evidence and return to an earlier one that it had dismissed when a later document changes the picture. In agentic software engineering (SWE), it may try several fixes for the same reproduced bug and return to an earlier repository state when a later test implicates code it had set aside. Yet a standard ReAct agent ( Yao et al., 2023b ) keeps all of this in one linear context. Every later model call then carries abandoned attempts and long off-path observations along with the evidence it needs, and undoing an attempt may also require undoing its effects on the environment. One remedy is to compress the history. Learned summarization and memory-consolidation methods select what past information remains available ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , but whatever they discard is gone for the rest of the episode. We instead keep several intermediate states that the agent can return to, and show the model only the context of the path it is currently working on.
paragraphs.zh: 在长期任务中，智能体很少能沿着一条直线路径直接找到解决方案。 多个候选解决方案可能基于相同的部分进展构建；一次失败的尝试仍可能达到一个值得从中恢复的状态；而后续的证据则可能使某个被放弃的方向值得重新审视。 在深度研究中，智能体可能会针对同一证据检查多个候选答案，并在后续文献改变原有认知时，回到此前曾被其忽略的早期答案。 在智能体驱动的软件工程（SWE）中，它可能会针对同一个复现的缺陷尝试多种修复方案，并在后续测试表明此前被搁置的代码存在问题时，恢复到早期的仓库状态。 然而，标准的 ReAct 智能体（Yao et al., 2023b）将所有这些信息都保留在单一的线性上下文中。 因此，每一次后续模型调用都会将已被放弃的尝试和偏离路径的长期观察结果与所需证据一同传递，而撤销一次尝试可能还需要撤销它对环境造成的影响。 一种解决方案是压缩历史记录。 基于学习的摘要生成和记忆整合方法会选择保留哪些过往信息（Zhou et al., 2026; Li et al., 2026），但任何被丢弃的信息在整个任务阶段都将无法再使用。 我们则选择保留多个智能体可以返回的中间状态，并且仅向模型展示其当前正在处理的路径所对应的上下文信息。

paragraphs.en: Tree-search methods for language models make alternative states explicit ( Yao et al., 2023a ; Hao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , but having a tree does not tell the agent which branch to work on next. A hand-designed DFS, BFS, or MCTS controller imposes its own selection rule. A learned score for each node is more adaptive, but it evaluates each node in isolation, while its usefulness changes as other branches reveal new evidence and the search approaches its limits. A score also leaves open how to continue from the selected state. In other words, the useful decision is often a node paired with a plan for what to do there, not a node alone. We therefore ask whether the model that does the task can also make this choice, based on what the search has found so far.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型的树搜索方法使替代状态变得明确（Yao 等人，2023a；Hao 等人，2023；Zhou 等人，2024），但拥有树结构并不会告诉智能体接下来应该处理哪条分支。 手动设计的 DFS、BFS 或 MCTS 控制器会施加其自身的选择规则。 为每个节点赋予一个学习得到的分数更具适应性，但它孤立地评估每个节点，而该节点的实际效用会随着其他分支揭示新证据以及搜索接近其极限而发生变化。 此外，仅凭分数也无法确定如何从所选状态继续执行。 换言之，有效的决策通常是一个节点与在该节点处应执行的操作计划相结合的结果，而非仅仅一个节点本身。 因此，我们提出一个问题：执行任务的模型是否也能基于搜索迄今的发现来做出这一选择。

paragraphs.en: A second question is how to train this behavior end to end. Standard agentic RL treats each episode as one growing token sequence with one final reward. A tree search breaks this assumption, because the model makes decisions from different saved states and therefore sees a different history each time. Concatenating all branches into one sequence would show the model histories it never saw during the search and bring back the long-context problem.

paragraphs.en: We introduce TreeFlex , a framework that saves the agent’s intermediate states as nodes of a search tree, each summarized by the model itself. The model works in two roles, Reflection and Execution (we later use each role’s name for the model acting in that role). In Reflection, it receives the original task and a short summary of every node, which we call its card, and selects one node together with a focused instruction. The harness then restores the path to that node for Execution, where the model uses the usual task tools to carry out the instruction and either saves a new checkpoint or proposes a final solution. Reflection then either approves the proposal, which ends the search, or rejects it by selecting one node to continue from. Continuing from the current node deepens a line, while returning to an earlier node or the root starts a new branch from that state. In classical search terms, Reflection manages the frontier, which is the set of states from which search can continue. For example, best-first search keeps this frontier as an open list ordered by priority. However, unlike such a list, Reflection can return to states it has already expanded, and it pairs each choice with an instruction. Figure 1 shows one such search.

paragraphs.en: This design lets the search grow without any context having to hold every branch. Reflection’s record grows by only one short card per node, and each Execution segment only sees one path. A node saves the environment state, such as a repository snapshot, as well as the raw prefix or a summary card for the segment, and returning to an earlier node restores the workspace. Therefore, the agent can use more compute to deepen a line, start a sibling, revisit earlier work, or verify a proposal without adding every explored branch to later Execution contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 这种设计允许搜索持续扩展，而无需任何上下文保留所有分支。 每次反射的记录仅因每个节点增加一张简短卡片，且每个执行段仅能看到一条路径。 一个节点会保存环境状态（例如仓库快照），以及原始前缀或该段的摘要卡片；返回到更早的节点即可恢复工作区。 因此，智能体可以使用更多计算资源来加深某条路径、启动并行路径、重新审视早期工作，或验证某个提案，而无需将所有已探索的分支添加到后续的执行上下文中。

paragraphs.en: We study TreeFlex on deep research with BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and on SWE with SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . On the BrowseComp-Plus test split used by FoldAgent ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , we compare it with flat ReAct , which keeps the whole history in one context, and FoldAgent under the same model and resource limits. Before RL, TreeFlex has the highest accuracy at both 4B and 30B. After RL training of Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) with a 32k active-context limit, TreeFlex reaches 48.8% accuracy, versus 41.5% for flat ReAct and 42.8% for FoldAgent , and 66.0% Pass@8, versus 56.0% and 55.3%. On SWE, we train TreeFlex and FoldAgent from Qwen3.5-9B with RL on SWE-Gym tasks ( Pan et al., 2025 ) and select each run’s training step on separate SWE-Gym validation tasks. TreeFlex resolves 54.9% of tasks, versus 43.3% for FoldAgent and 45.2% for a FoldAgent variant with a step-wise delegation prompt that we wrote.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于 BrowseComp-Plus（Chen 等人，2026）开展的深度研究以及 SWE-bench Verified（Jimenez 等人，2024；OpenAI，2024）中的 SWE 任务，对 TreeFlex 进行了研究。 在 FoldAgent（Sun 等人，2026）使用的 BrowseComp-Plus 测试分集中，我们将它与将全部历史保留在单一上下文中的 flat ReAct，以及在相同模型和资源限制下的 FoldAgent 进行了比较。 在强化学习之前，TreeFlex 在 4B 和 30B 两种规模下均具有最高的准确率。 使用 32k 的活跃上下文限制对 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507（Qwen 团队，2025）进行强化学习训练后，TreeFlex 的准确率达到 48.8%，而 flat ReAct 为 41.5%，FoldAgent 为 42.8%；其 Pass@8 为 66.0%，而另外两种方法分别为 56.0% 和 55.3%。 在 SWE 任务中，我们从 Qwen3.5-9B 出发，通过 SWE-Gym 任务（Pan 等人，2025）对 TreeFlex 和 FoldAgent 进行强化学习训练，并为每次运行在独立的 SWE-Gym 验证任务上选择训练步数。 TreeFlex 解决了 54.9% 的任务，而 FoldAgent 为 43.3%，我们编写的采用分步委托提示的 FoldAgent 变体则为 45.2%。

paragraphs.en: The language model acts in two roles that differ only in what they see and which tools they can call (Table 1 ). In Reflection, it sees the original task and a global record with one entry per node, which gives the node’s identifier, parent, and card but not the raw context of any segment. In Execution, it sees the path view : the context restored along the path from the root to the selected node, the selected node’s environment state e v e_{v} , and the new instruction, but nothing from other branches. In deep research, retrieved evidence can be cited in a card and fetched again, so the restored context consists only of the cards along the path. In SWE, error traces and diffs are hard to summarize faithfully, so the restored context is the raw context along the path. When it no longer fits, the harness stores a compact resumable context containing the path cards and a truncated repository diff (Appendix A.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该语言模型以两种角色行动，这两种角色的区别仅在于它们能看到什么以及可以调用哪些工具（表 1）。 在“反思”阶段，它能看到原始任务和一个全局记录，其中每个节点有一条记录，包含节点的标识符、父节点和卡片，但不包含任何分段的原始上下文。 在“执行”阶段，它能看到路径视图：从根节点到所选节点的路径上恢复的上下文、所选节点的环境状态 e v e_{v} 以及新指令，但看不到其他分支的任何内容。 在深度研究中，检索到的证据可以在卡片中引用并再次获取，因此恢复的上下文仅包含路径上的卡片。 在 SWE 中，错误追踪和差异难以准确概括，因此恢复的上下文是路径上的原始上下文。 当内容不再适合时，执行框架会存储一个可续传的紧凑上下文，其中包含路径卡片和一个截断后的仓库差异（附录 A.2）。

paragraphs.en: A search alternates between the two roles. Reflection’s first navigate call must choose the root. Each Execution segment ends with checkpoint or commit . paragraphs.en: Reflection’s choices shape the tree. Resuming the latest node deepens the current line, resuming an earlier node starts a sibling branch, and resuming the root starts a new line. The search can therefore behave like depth-first, breadth-first, or best-first search, and the model learns when to do which, without a fixed rule. Segments run one at a time, without parallel model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的选择塑造了这棵树。 恢复最新节点会加深当前路径，恢复更早的节点则会开启一个兄弟分支，而恢复根节点则会开始一条新路径。 因此，搜索过程可以表现为深度优先、广度优先或最佳优先搜索，模型无需固定规则即可自行决定何时采用哪种方式。 各段依次执行，不会并行调用模型。

sents.en: The search can therefore behave like depth-first, breadth-first, or best-first search, and the model learns when to do which, without a fixed rule.
sents.zh: 因此，搜索过程可以表现为深度优先、广度优先或最佳优先搜索，模型无需固定规则即可自行决定何时采用哪种方式。

sents.en: Segments run one at a time, without parallel model calls.
sents.zh: 各段依次执行，不会并行调用模型。

paragraphs.en: In standard agentic RL, a rollout is one growing token sequence. In contrast, a TreeFlex search or rollout is split across several sequences, because Reflection keeps its own context and each Execution segment starts from the saved context of its selected node. Training on such a search raises two questions: what counts as one sample and which context each output is trained on. For the first, we treat each complete search as one rollout and one member of its GRPO group, since only the complete search receives a task reward. The task reward therefore applies to every output in the search, whereas a process penalty applies only to the turn it concerns. For the second, each output is trained on exactly the context it was generated from. Its log-probability is computed given that context, and the restored context is used only as input, so the loss applies only to tokens the model newly generated.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准的智能体强化学习中，一次展开就是一个不断增长的令牌序列。 相比之下，TreeFlex 搜索或展开则被分割到多个序列中，因为 Reflection 会保留自身的上下文，而每个 Execution 片段都从所选节点的已保存上下文开始。 基于此类搜索进行训练会引发两个问题：什么才算一个样本，以及每个输出是基于哪个上下文训练的。 对于第一个问题，我们将每次完整的搜索视为一次展开及其 GRPO 组的一个成员，因为只有完整的搜索才会获得任务奖励。 因此，任务奖励适用于搜索中的每一个输出，而过程惩罚仅适用于其对应的回合。 对于第二个问题，每个输出都严格基于其生成时所用的上下文进行训练。 其对数概率是在该上下文中计算的，且恢复的上下文仅作为输入使用，因此损失仅适用于模型新生成的令牌。

paragraphs.en: A causal block is a maximal sequence over which context grows only by appending tokens. It therefore preserves the exact prefix from which each generated token was sampled. An Execution segment ends with checkpoint or commit , and the next segment starts from a restored context, so each segment forms its own block. paragraphs.en: We evaluate deep research with BrowseComp-Plus, whose compositional questions require finding and synthesizing evidence across multiple documents in a frozen corpus ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . We use the train/test split of Sun et al. (2026) , with 680 training and 150 test questions, and further hold out 64 of the training questions as a fixed validation split, leaving 616 for training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 BrowseComp-Plus 对深度研究进行评估，其组合性问题要求在一个固定语料库中跨多份文档查找并综合证据（Chen et al., 2026）。我们采用 Sun et al. (2026) 提供的训练/测试划分，其中包含 680 个训练问题和 150 个测试问题，并进一步将 64 个训练问题保留为固定验证集，剩余 616 个问题用于训练。

paragraphs.en: We draw 600 executable Python repository tasks from SWE-Gym ( Pan et al., 2025 ) , spanning ten repositories, and split them into 500 training tasks and 100 validation tasks. Each task pairs a natural-language issue with a repository snapshot and hidden executable tests. We train each method on tasks on which earlier training rollouts had mixed outcomes. FoldAgent trains on the 217 tasks on which its own rollouts had mixed outcomes, and TreeFlex on the 250 tasks on which the rollouts of either method had mixed outcomes. Evaluation uses all 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks and the official grader ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . Appendix D.1 describes how the training tasks were selected.

paragraphs.en: Following Sun et al. (2026) , we train all three methods on the same data for 50 steps, using 32 questions per step, eight rollouts per question, and a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} . The methods differ in their training objectives: TreeFlex uses tree-aware GRPO, FoldAgent uses FoldGRPO, and flat ReAct uses GRPO. We make four changes to the original setup. We use a 4B rather than a 36B model, select each run’s training checkpoint on the validation split, and sample eight rollouts per test question rather than one greedy rollout. We also apply the 32k active-context limit to the context after the initial prompt and use a larger model window so that the next call still fits. paragraphs.en: Table 3 compares the two systems before and after RL. It also includes a FoldAgent variant with a step-wise delegation prompt, described below. Without task-specific RL, TreeFlex reaches 51.1% Mean@3 and 64.4% Pass@3, versus 31.7% and 44.0% for FoldAgent . RL raises FoldAgent by 11.7 points, mostly by teaching it to finish within the context limit. The share of its rollouts that end with finish rises from 4% to 17%, and rollouts that finish and resolve the task account for 9.7 of the 11.7 points. paragraphs.en: With the released FoldAgent prompt, the base Qwen3.5-9B model almost never launches a branch. Only 2 of its 1,500 rollouts on SWE-bench Verified do, so nearly every rollout keeps all its work in the main context, and 96% of rollouts end at the context limit. We therefore wrote a step-wise delegation prompt that asks the main agent to split the repair into a sequence of small branches, each returning one checkable result such as one edit or one focused test run, and to choose each next branch from the report the previous one returns (Appendix F.7 ). This raises FoldAgent to 49.5% Mean@3, close to TreeFlex ’s 51.1%, although only 42% of its rollouts end with finish (Appendix E.2 ). RL on top of this prompt lowers its resolve rate to 45.2%. During training, this variant receives a positive task reward only if the main agent calls finish , whereas test grading evaluates the final workspace whether or not finish is called. RL increases the share of rollouts that both finish and resolve the task from 31.5% to 40.8%, but reduces the share that resolve without finish from 18.1% to 4.4%.

paragraphs.en: In game playing, AlphaZero and ELF OpenGo pair Monte Carlo tree search with a learned policy-value network ( Silver et al., 2018 ; Tian et al., 2019 ) . The search algorithm is fixed, and the network supplies priors and value estimates. Tree of Thoughts, Graph of Thoughts, world-model planning, and Language Agent Tree Search bring tree and graph search to language models ( Yao et al., 2023a ; Besta et al., 2024 ; Hao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) . The language model proposes partial solutions and usually scores them, and a fixed procedure decides which to expand next. This procedure is breadth- or depth-first search in Tree of Thoughts, MCTS in world-model planning and Language Agent Tree Search, and a user-specified graph of operations in Graph of Thoughts. For web agents, Koh et al. (2025) run a best-first search guided by a prompted value function and restore pages by resetting the environment and replaying actions. Policy-Guided Tree Search instead trains a separate graph-network policy with RL to decide whether to expand, branch, backtrack, or stop over the reasoning steps of an unmodified language model ( Li, 2025 ) . Stream of Search, Searchformer, and Dualformer train models on serialized search traces ( Gandhi et al., 2024 ; Lehnert et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2025 ) , and ASTRO trains on CoT traces converted from Monte Carlo tree search ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . In all four, the search is written out as one sequence, so returning to an earlier node means writing it out again rather than restoring a saved state. TreeFlex instead lets the agent’s own policy choose which saved node to resume and what to do there, while the harness restores the corresponding context and environment state.
paragraphs.zh: 在游戏领域，AlphaZero 和 ELF OpenGo 将蒙特卡洛树搜索与学习到的策略-价值网络相结合（Silver 等人，2018；Tian 等人，2019）。 搜索算法是固定的，而网络则提供先验信息和价值估计。 “思维树”“思维图”、世界模型规划和语言智能体树搜索将树搜索和图搜索引入语言模型（Yao 等人，2023a；Besta 等人，2024；Hao 等人，2023；Zhou 等人，2024）。 语言模型会提出部分解决方案并通常对其进行评分，而一个固定程序则决定下一步扩展哪一个。 在“思维树”中，该程序是广度或深度优先搜索；在世界模型规划和语言智能体树搜索中，是 MCTS；而在“思维图”中，则是用户指定的操作图。 对于网络智能体，Koh 等人 （2025）通过提示引导的价值函数运行最佳优先搜索，并通过重置环境和重放动作来恢复页面。 “策略引导树搜索”则通过强化学习训练一个独立的图网络策略，以在未修改的语言模型的推理步骤中决定是扩展、分支、回溯还是停止（Li，2025）。 “搜索流”“Searchformer”和“Dualformer”在序列化搜索轨迹上训练模型（Gandhi 等人，2024；Lehnert 等人，2024；Su 等人，2025），而 ASTRO 则在从蒙特卡洛树搜索转换而来的 CoT 轨迹上进行训练（Kim 等人，2025）。 在这四种方法中，搜索过程都以单一序列的形式输出，因此要返回到早期节点，必须重新将其写出，而不是恢复已保存的状态。 相比之下，“TreeFlex”允许智能体自身的策略选择要恢复的哪个已保存节点以及在该节点执行的操作，同时由框架恢复相应的上下文和环境状态。

sents.en: Tree of Thoughts, Graph of Thoughts, world-model planning, and Language Agent Tree Search bring tree and graph search to language models ( Yao et al., 2023a ; Besta et al., 2024 ; Hao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: “思维树”“思维图”、世界模型规划和语言智能体树搜索将树搜索和图搜索引入语言模型（Yao 等人，2023a；Besta 等人，2024；Hao 等人，2023；Zhou 等人，2024）。

sents.en: The language model proposes partial solutions and usually scores them, and a fixed procedure decides which to expand next.
sents.zh: 语言模型会提出部分解决方案并通常对其进行评分，而一个固定程序则决定下一步扩展哪一个。

sents.en: This procedure is breadth- or depth-first search in Tree of Thoughts, MCTS in world-model planning and Language Agent Tree Search, and a user-specified graph of operations in Graph of Thoughts.
sents.zh: 在“思维树”中，该程序是广度或深度优先搜索；在世界模型规划和语言智能体树搜索中，是 MCTS；而在“思维图”中，则是用户指定的操作图。

sents.en: (2025) run a best-first search guided by a prompted value function and restore pages by resetting the environment and replaying actions.

sents.en: Policy-Guided Tree Search instead trains a separate graph-network policy with RL to decide whether to expand, branch, backtrack, or stop over the reasoning steps of an unmodified language model ( Li, 2025 ) .
sents.zh: “策略引导树搜索”则通过强化学习训练一个独立的图网络策略，以在未修改的语言模型的推理步骤中决定是扩展、分支、回溯还是停止（Li，2025）。

sents.en: Stream of Search, Searchformer, and Dualformer train models on serialized search traces ( Gandhi et al., 2024 ; Lehnert et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2025 ) , and ASTRO trains on CoT traces converted from Monte Carlo tree search ( Kim et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: “搜索流”“Searchformer”和“Dualformer”在序列化搜索轨迹上训练模型（Gandhi 等人，2024；Lehnert 等人，2024；Su 等人，2025），而 ASTRO 则在从蒙特卡洛树搜索转换而来的 CoT 轨迹上进行训练（Kim 等人，2025）。

sents.en: In all four, the search is written out as one sequence, so returning to an earlier node means writing it out again rather than restoring a saved state.
sents.zh: 在这四种方法中，搜索过程都以单一序列的形式输出，因此要返回到早期节点，必须重新将其写出，而不是恢复已保存的状态。

sents.en: TreeFlex instead lets the agent’s own policy choose which saved node to resume and what to do there, while the harness restores the corresponding context and environment state.
sents.zh: 相比之下，“TreeFlex”允许智能体自身的策略选择要恢复的哪个已保存节点以及在该节点执行的操作，同时由框架恢复相应的上下文和环境状态。

paragraphs.en: RL has trained language models to interleave reasoning with search, as in Search-R1 and R1-Searcher ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ) , and DeepResearcher scales this training to real web environments ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: At the reasoning-trace level, Accordion-Thinking learns when to summarize completed steps and discard their detailed token history ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . MEM1 rewrites a compact internal state at every turn and discards the rest of its context, so its memory stays nearly constant in size ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . MemPO trains the agent to write its own memory summaries and rewards each summary by how much it raises the model’s probability of the correct answer ( Li et al., 2026 ) . For long-horizon web search, AgentFold learns at each step either to condense the latest step into a short summary or to merge it with recent summaries into a coarser one ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , and LongSeeker lets the agent summarize past steps, cut tool outputs down to exact excerpts, delete steps, or roll back to an earlier step ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Context-Folding trains FoldAgent to run subtasks in temporary branches and fold each back into the main context as a report ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . These approaches make compression or retention part of the agent’s behavior, but keep only the current working history, so discarded work cannot be resumed later.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理追踪层面，Accordion-Thinking 能够判断何时对已完成步骤进行总结，并丢弃其详细的标记历史（Yang et al., 2026）。 MEM1 在每个回合都会重写一个紧凑的内部状态，并丢弃其余上下文内容，因此其内存大小几乎保持不变（Zhou et al., 2026）。 MemPO 训练智能体自行编写记忆摘要，并根据摘要提升模型对正确答案预测概率的程度来给予奖励（Li et al., 2026）。 对于长期网络搜索任务，AgentFold 在每个步骤中会学习将最新步骤浓缩为简短摘要，或将其与近期摘要合并为更粗略的摘要（Ye et al., 2026）；而 LongSeeker 则允许智能体总结过往步骤、将工具输出裁剪为精确摘录、删除步骤，或回退到更早的步骤（Lu et al., 2026）。 Context-Folding 训练 FoldAgent 在临时分支中执行子任务，并将每个分支的结果以报告形式折叠回主上下文（Sun et al., 2026）。 这些方法将压缩或保留信息作为智能体行为的一部分，但仅保留当前的工作历史，因此被丢弃的工作无法后续恢复。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench evaluates whether an agent can resolve real repository issues under executable tests ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , while SWE-Gym supplies repository tasks and environments for training agents and verifiers ( Pan et al., 2025 ) . OpenHands provides an open platform in which software agents act through CodeAct-style code execution ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . SWE-agent designs the commands and feedback format for an agent that edits one workspace along a single ReAct-style trajectory ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Agentless instead samples many candidate patches independently from a fixed pipeline of localization, repair, and patch validation, and filters them with tests ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . SWE-Search runs Monte Carlo tree search over repository states kept in a git-like commit tree, selecting nodes with a hand-designed rule and scoring them with a prompted language model ( Antoniades et al., 2025 ) . In TreeFlex , the trained policy itself chooses which saved repository state to work from next.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 评估智能体是否能在可执行测试下解决真实代码库问题（Jimenez 等，2024），而 SWE-Gym 则为训练智能体和验证器提供代码库任务与环境（Pan 等，2025）。 OpenHands 提供了一个开放平台，软件智能体可在其中通过 CodeAct 风格的代码执行进行操作（Wang 等，2025）。 SWE-agent 为能够沿单条 ReAct 风格轨迹编辑一个工作区的智能体设计了命令与反馈格式（Yang 等，2024）。 Agentless 则从固定的定位、修复和补丁验证流程中独立采样多个候选补丁，并通过测试进行筛选（Xia 等，2025）。 SWE-Search 在类 git 提交树中保存的代码库状态上运行蒙特卡洛树搜索，通过人工设计的规则选择节点，并由提示语言模型进行评分（Antoniades 等，2025）。 在 TreeFlex 中，训练好的策略本身会决定接下来应基于哪个已保存的代码库状态开展工作。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments are small in scale. We train a 4B model on 616 deep-research questions and a 9B model on at most 250 SWE tasks. Each training configuration is run once, so our significance tests capture question sampling but not variation across training runs. The comparisons are between complete systems that also differ in prompts and tool interfaces. TreeFlex uses more inference-time computation than the baselines, and its segments run sequentially, which adds latency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验规模较小。 我们在 616 个深度研究问题上训练了一个 4B 模型，并在最多 250 个 SWE 任务上训练了一个 9B 模型。 每种训练配置仅运行一次，因此我们的显著性检验能够反映问题采样带来的差异，但无法反映不同训练运行之间的差异。 这些比较是在完整系统之间进行的，而这些系统在提示词和工具接口方面也存在差异。 TreeFlex 在推理阶段使用的计算资源比基线模型更多，并且其各个分段是顺序执行的，这会增加延迟。

paragraphs.en: Training at a larger scale would show whether these results hold for stronger models, more training data, and longer training. On SWE, validation accuracy was still rising at the last saved step, so longer training may help there directly. SFT on successful searches that save, compare, and revisit nodes could give RL a better starting point in both domains. Future work could also reward efficiency directly by penalizing generated tokens or tool calls in successful searches.
paragraphs.zh: 更大规模的训练将表明，这些结果是否适用于更强大的模型、更多的训练数据以及更长的训练时间。 在 SWE 上，最后一个保存步骤时验证准确率仍在上升，因此更长的训练可能直接有助于改善这一情况。 对能够保存、比较和重新访问节点的成功搜索进行 SFT，可以为 RL 在这两个领域提供更好的起点。 未来的工作也可以通过对成功搜索中生成的标记或工具调用进行惩罚，从而直接奖励效率。

paragraphs.en: TreeFlex saves an agent’s progress as nodes of a search tree, lets one model choose which node to resume and what work to do there, and trains both roles end to end with tree-aware GRPO. Across both domains, TreeFlex solves more tasks than baselines trained from the same starting model.
paragraphs.zh: TreeFlex 将智能体的进度保存为搜索树的节点，允许一个模型选择要恢复的节点以及在该节点需要执行的任务，并通过感知树结构的 GRPO 对这两种角色进行端到端的训练。 在两个领域内，TreeFlex 解决的问题数量都超过了使用相同初始模型训练的基线方法。

paragraphs.en: Each training row has a prompt part and a response part of fixed length, and the loss applies only to tokens in the response part. A causal block starts with restored context and continues with the tokens the model generated in that segment. We put as much of the restored context as fits into the prompt part, and everything from the first generated token onward into the response part. Restored context that does not fit goes into the response part but is left out of the loss, so the model still sees it but is not trained on it. If the response part is too long, we split the block into several rows, and we split only between model calls. Every token is therefore trained on exactly the context it was generated from.
paragraphs.zh: 每个训练行都包含一个固定长度的提示部分和一个响应部分，且损失仅应用于响应部分中的词元。 一个因果块以恢复的上下文开头，随后是该模型在此段中生成的词元。 我们将尽可能多的恢复上下文放入提示部分，并将从第一个生成词元开始的所有内容放入响应部分。 无法完全容纳的恢复上下文会进入响应部分，但不会被计入损失，因此模型仍然能看到它，但不会基于它进行训练。 如果响应部分过长，我们会将该块拆分为多个行，且拆分仅发生在模型调用之间。 因此，每个词元都恰好基于其生成时所依据的上下文进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Each causal block becomes one training row, or several rows if it is too long (Appendix B.1 ). All rows of a rollout share its advantage. We compute the weights of Equation ( 3 ) from token counts over the whole minibatch, before the minibatch is split across GPUs and microbatches. Padding rows therefore get zero weight, and the split does not change the token mean or the rollout mean. The block mean weights every row equally, so a block split into several rows counts once per row.

paragraphs.en: When more than one penalty applies to a token, we use the most negative one. The failure penalty applies only to the failed generated action. In BrowseComp-Plus, the out-of-scope penalty applies only to generated retrieval actions labelled out of scope, and never to checkpoint or proposal turns. In the ablations, the finalization penalty applies to a Reflection instruction that asks Execution to produce the answer instead of finding new evidence. A fixed text pattern or the OOS judge flags such instructions. Three kinds of instruction are exempt. They are requests to write up a card, verification requests such as “finalize whether X holds by checking Y”, and the final instruction Reflection gives when its navigations or turns run out, since that last segment must end with a proposal. We leave out of training any rollout whose correctness judgment is ambiguous. We give no positive reward for nodes, navigation targets, or tree shape. Appendix C.3 gives the judges, and Appendix C.5 gives optimizer, evaluator, and sampling settings.

paragraphs.en: All BrowseComp-Plus methods are scored by the same fixed judge. The released FoldAgent implementation normalizes parenthetical qualifiers, years, function words, token order, title prefixes, and some first names before invoking its language-model judge ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . This normalization can let a partial answer count as correct, so we add a second check that tends to reject wrong answers.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 BrowseComp-Plus 方法都由同一个固定评判者进行评分。 已发布的 FoldAgent 实现会在调用其语言模型评判者之前，对括号内的限定词、年份、功能词、词元顺序、标题前缀以及某些名字进行标准化（Sun et al., 2026）。 这种标准化可能导致部分答案被判定为正确，因此我们增加了一个倾向于拒绝错误答案的第二层检查。

sents.en: All BrowseComp-Plus methods are scored by the same fixed judge.
sents.zh: 所有 BrowseComp-Plus 方法都由同一个固定评判者进行评分。

sents.en: The released FoldAgent implementation normalizes parenthetical qualifiers, years, function words, token order, title prefixes, and some first names before invoking its language-model judge ( Sun et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 已发布的 FoldAgent 实现会在调用其语言模型评判者之前，对括号内的限定词、年份、功能词、词元顺序、标题前缀以及某些名字进行标准化（Sun et al., 2026）。

sents.en: This normalization can let a partial answer count as correct, so we add a second check that tends to reject wrong answers.
sents.zh: 这种标准化可能导致部分答案被判定为正确，因此我们增加了一个倾向于拒绝错误答案的第二层检查。

paragraphs.en: An answer is accepted without the language-model judge only if it exactly matches the gold answer, a recorded alias for that question, or the same number written plainly. Our normalization rules are conservative. They can flag two answers as possibly equivalent, but they cannot mark an answer correct on their own. Fixed rules reject an answer if its numbers conflict with the gold answer, if it changes a sign or a percentage, if it adds a qualifier to a title, or if it adds a bibliographic suffix that the gold answer does not support.
paragraphs.zh: 只有在答案与标准答案、该问题已记录的别名或相同数字的明文表述完全一致时，语言模型裁判才会接受该答案。 我们的规范化规则较为保守。 它们可以将两个答案标记为可能等价，但无法自行判定某个答案为正确。 固定规则会拒绝某个答案，如果其数字与标准答案冲突、改变了符号或百分比、在标题中添加了限定词，或者添加了标准答案不支持的文献引用后缀。

sents.zh: 只有在答案与标准答案、该问题已记录的别名或相同数字的明文表述完全一致时，语言模型裁判才会接受该答案。

sents.zh: 我们的规范化规则较为保守。

sents.en: Fixed rules reject an answer if its numbers conflict with the gold answer, if it changes a sign or a percentage, if it adds a qualifier to a title, or if it adds a bibliographic suffix that the gold answer does not support.
sents.zh: 固定规则会拒绝某个答案，如果其数字与标准答案冲突、改变了符号或百分比、在标题中添加了限定词，或者添加了标准答案不支持的文献引用后缀。

paragraphs.en: Every other answer is judged once by Qwen3-32B under a fixed prompt. If Qwen3-32B’s verdict disagrees with the fixed rules, or if the answer looks suspiciously close to the gold answer, we sample three more verdicts. We use these verdicts only if all three agree. If the three verdicts disagree, the answer is ambiguous, and we leave the rollout out of the policy loss and the GRPO group statistics. With this check, the judge accepts fewer wrong answers but also rejects some correct ones.
paragraphs.zh: 其余所有答案都由 Qwen3-32B 在固定提示下进行一次判断。 如果 Qwen3-32B 的判断与固定规则不符，或者答案看起来与标准答案过于接近，我们会再采样三个判断结果。 只有当这三个判断结果全部一致时，我们才会使用这些判断结果。 如果三个判断结果不一致，则说明该答案存在歧义，此时我们将不将该次推理过程纳入策略损失和 GRPO 组统计中。 通过这种检查，判断者虽然能接受更少的错误答案，但也会拒绝一些正确答案。

paragraphs.en: FoldAgent decides whether a branch stayed in scope by comparing the branch’s assignment with the report it returns ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . For TreeFlex ’s Execution segments, we judge each retrieval action instead, since a report can leave out work or credit work to the wrong step. The judge sees only the original question, the card of the selected node, the assigned instruction, and up to eight recent instructions given at that node. For each search or get_document call, it also sees the truncated arguments, information about the results, and whether the call succeeded. The judge does not see the gold answer, the reward, or whether the final answer was correct.
paragraphs.zh: FoldAgent 通过将分支的分配任务与其返回的报告进行比较，来决定该分支是否保持在作用域内（Sun 等人，2026）。 对于 TreeFlex 的执行段，我们则对每次检索操作进行判断，因为报告可能会遗漏某些工作，或将工作错误地归因于某个步骤。 评判者只能看到原始问题、所选节点的卡片、分配的任务，以及在该节点给出的最多八条最近指令。 对于每次搜索或 get_document 调用，它还能看到被截断的参数、有关结果的信息，以及该调用是否成功。 评判者看不到标准答案、奖励，也不知道最终答案是否正确。

paragraphs.en: The Qwen3-32B judge also labels each instruction as focused, broad, redundant, finalization, or uncertain. The instruction labels do not change the OOS penalty. The ablations use the finalization label to apply the Reflection finalization penalty. Each action is labeled in scope, necessary verification, redundant, out of scope, or uncertain. Only an out-of-scope action is penalized, with Q = − 0.2 Q=-0.2 on the turn that made the call. The judge’s output must label every action exactly once. If the judge’s output is malformed, or the request to the judge fails or times out, we apply no out-of-scope penalty in that segment. Appendix F.4 gives the exact prompt.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3-32B 裁判还将每条指令标记为“聚焦”“宽泛”“冗余”“最终化”或“不确定”。 指令标签不会改变 OOS 惩罚。 消融研究使用“最终化”标签来应用“反思最终化”惩罚。 每个动作都会被标记为“在范围内”“必要验证”“冗余”“超出范围”或“不确定”。 只有超出范围的动作会受到惩罚，在发出该调用的回合中，Q = −0.2。 裁判的输出必须对每个动作恰好标记一次。 如果裁判的输出格式错误，或者对裁判的请求失败或超时，我们不会在该片段中应用任何超出范围的惩罚。 附录 F.4 提供了确切的提示词。

paragraphs.en: GRPO learns nothing from the task reward when all rollouts of a task fail or all succeed. We therefore keep the training tasks on which a method’s earlier training rollouts both succeeded and failed. For TreeFlex , a rollout counts as successful only if it resolves the task with an approved proposal. The filter keeps 217 tasks for FoldAgent and 191 for TreeFlex . Of these, 158 are in both sets and 250 are in at least one. TreeFlex and the step-wise FoldAgent variant train on the union, and FoldAgent trains on its own 217 tasks, because the other 33 never gave it mixed outcomes. We pick these subsets using only training tasks and their training rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 当某项任务的所有执行结果都失败或全部成功时，GRPO 无法从该任务的奖励中学到任何东西。 因此，我们保留那些方法早期训练执行结果既成功又失败的训练任务。 对于 TreeFlex，只有当执行结果通过批准的提案解决了任务时，才被视为成功。 筛选器为 FoldAgent 保留了 217 个任务，为 TreeFlex 保留了 191 个任务。 其中，有 158 个任务同时存在于两个集合中，另有 250 个任务至少出现在其中一个集合中。 TreeFlex 和分步 FoldAgent 变体在它们的并集上进行训练，而 FoldAgent 则仅在其自身的 217 个任务上训练，因为其余的 33 个任务从未产生混合结果。 我们仅使用训练任务及其训练执行结果来选择这些子集。

paragraphs.en: Both methods run the model with a context window of 57,344 tokens. The initial prompt may take up to 16,384 tokens, and the context may then grow by at most 32,768 tokens before the method must compact it or stop. paragraphs.en: Both methods use PPO minibatches of 16 tasks and normalize advantages by the group standard deviation. Every run saves its model every five steps. Ties in validation Mean@3 go to the earlier step, and the selection picks step 25 for TreeFlex and step 10 for both FoldAgent variants. During training, both sample with temperature 1, top- p p 1, no top- k k cutoff (top- k = − 1 k=-1 ), and min- p p 0. TreeFlex and FoldAgent with its released prompt keep the failure penalty and turn off the out-of-scope and unfolded-context penalties. The out-of-scope and unfolded-context penalties assume that the agent branches. For a successful rollout that never branches, the released FoldAgent code penalizes every turn and by default sets the reward to zero. FoldAgent branches in under 1% of SWE rollouts, so keeping the two penalties would remove almost all of its learning signal.
paragraphs.zh: 两种方法都使用包含 16 个任务的 PPO 小批量，并通过组标准差对优势值进行归一化。 每次运行都会每五个步骤保存一次模型。 如果验证 Mean@3 出现并列，则选择较早的步骤；最终选择 TreeFlex 的步骤 25，以及两种 FoldAgent 变体的步骤 10。 在训练期间，两者均以温度 1、top-p=1、无 top-k 截断（top-k=-1）以及 min-p=0 进行采样。 TreeFlex 和发布了提示词的 FoldAgent 保留了失败惩罚，但关闭了超出范围和解卷上下文相关的惩罚。 超出范围和解卷上下文相关的惩罚假设智能体会进行分支。 对于从未分支的成功展开过程，已发布的 FoldAgent 代码会对每一步都施加惩罚，并将奖励默认设为零。 FoldAgent 在 SWE 展开中的分支比例低于 1%，因此保留这两种惩罚几乎会消除其全部学习信号。

paragraphs.en: The trace shows three behaviors. First, the model saves a checkpoint to note an open question and later turns that question into the instruction for a new segment. Second, it tries a sibling branch and then resumes the line that holds the evidence. The Execution segment on that line does not see the sibling’s card. Third, during Execution it corrects a flawed instruction using the documents it reads. Throughout, the harness only restores the states that the model selects.
